init_tokenizer: initialize a Tokenizer instance with a SentencePiece model file path
encode_text: encode a string into a list of token IDs with optional BOS and EOS tokens
decode_tokens: decode a list of token IDs back into a human-readable string
review_tokenizer_class: review the Tokenizer class and its SentencePiece-based encoding and decoding methods
summarize_tokenizer_api: summarize the Tokenizer API including encode, decode, and special token ID attributes
